nodes.name: Prepare Nexus Input
nodes.notes: For Manual Trigger runs, fill manualInput in this node. Webhook/Form/parent workflows can provide task, project_key, issue_number, and repo_dir on the incoming item instead.

nodes.name: Create Nexus Run
nodes.notes: Creates the durable Nexus run that n8n will advance.

nodes.name: 01 Start research
nodes.notes: Gather relevant context about the topic from the issue description, linked docs, web search results, and any project knowledge base. Produce a structured brief: key facts, tone, audience, CTA suggestion, and 3–5 relevant hashtags.

nodes.name: Complete research
nodes.notes: Replace this state transition with a concrete agent/tool call when available.

nodes.name: 02 Start write
nodes.notes: Write a high-quality LinkedIn post based on the research brief. Format: hook (1–2 lines) → body (insight or story, 3–5 paragraphs) → CTA → hashtags. Tone: professional but human. Max 3000 characters. No generic openers. Output the final post text only — no markdown formatting wrappers.

nodes.name: Complete write
nodes.notes: Replace this state transition with a concrete agent/tool call when available.

nodes.name: 03 Start review
nodes.notes: Review the post for: accuracy, tone consistency, platform compliance (LinkedIn rules), brand voice, no unverified claims, appropriate hashtag count (3–5). Either approve or request specific changes with actionable feedback.

nodes.name: Complete review
nodes.notes: Replace this state transition with a concrete agent/tool call when available.

nodes.name: Route route_review
nodes.notes: Evaluates Nexus route rules and writes next_step.

nodes.name: 05 Start publish
nodes.notes: Publish the approved post to LinkedIn. First run a dry_run to validate credentials and content format. If dry_run passes, call social:publish with platform=linkedin. Post the publish result (post URL or error) as a comment. DO NOT publish without a passing dry_run.

nodes.name: Approval Gate publish
nodes.notes: Connect this node to an n8n approval/wait mechanism if the gate must pause.

nodes.name: Complete publish
nodes.notes: Replace this state transition with a concrete agent/tool call when available.

nodes.name: 06 Start close_loop
nodes.notes: Write a short summary of the published post (platform, URL, reach estimate). Close the issue with label social:published.

nodes.name: Complete close_loop
nodes.notes: Replace this state transition with a concrete agent/tool call when available.

nodes.name: Switch route_review
nodes.notes: Routes to the Nexus step selected by the preceding Code node.
